about: Phase 2 of 3, independent of the order of the others except that it runs BEFORE cred-rename-apply.yml (which would otherwise rename these three titles with their exhibits). Sam's IC ruling covers every industry-certification exhibit under a '(ASE ... standards)' title; three more sit under folds the earlier read did not list, all Mt. San Jacinto: MAPICO-IAEI (IC- Automotive Electrical/Electronics I) and MAPICO-IEI (IC-Automotive Electrical/Electronics II) to ASE A6 — Electrical/Electronic Systems, and MAPICO-IEPI (IC- Engine Performance II) to ASE A8 — Engine Performance. Each source title is then empty, so its saved override retires, and Electrical/Electronic Systems 1 and 2 (ASE A6 standards) and Engine Performance 2 (ASE A8 standards) are never created. Their issuer rows are empty, so no college joins a certification's issuers. Each retire names the row's reviewed_at from kb/credential_review_overlay.json (synced 2026-11-11 ~17:40Z), which keeps one stamp per title, not per row: replace each with the per-row stamp from kb/cer_decisions_out/2026-11-11-s638/00_fresh_reads.sql before the dry run. A stamp that does not match holds that row and with it the whole commit, and the dry run prints the live stamp.
ruling: Sam Lee, in session 2026-11-11 (SkyTamarind, S638; cpl_memory sam-ase-mil-certs-and-cx-to-standards-2026-11-11, sam-ic-exhibits-go-to-cert-title-2026-11-11, sam-cert-name-first-2026-11-11): 'ASE MIL3 test is the Military Tactical Wheeled Vehicle (TWV) – Drive Train certification... if there are any exhibits with ASE MIL in the title, adjust the canonical title to match the official ASE titles'; an industry-certification exhibit under a '(ASE ... standards)' title goes to the cert title, and ('3 yes') the credit-by-exam exhibits under the A5, A7 and A8 cert titles go to the standards titles; then his authorization the same day for the conductor and COBIx to settle the emptied titles without bringing them back to him. Superseding his own 2026-10-31 to 11-11 saves by his word (CLAUDE.md Rule 8); written by SkyTamarind's worker
